paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 1:13.[^1]

notes.text: The printed ויק״ר פ״א-יג is read as Vayikra Rabbah, parashah 1, section 13. The numerals are decoded from the source without independent modern-edition verification. The heading abbreviates the personal title, retained as R'.
